basic_info.description: Welcome to this enchanting custom-built home. This home, never previously on the market, was custom built by the seller's grandfather with unique touches that are rare to find.  What an opportunity to have a piece of history in a highly desirable neighborhood.  The extra wide tunnel entry enclosed with decorative wrought-iron and featuring a custom skylight which creates a wonderful bright atrium. Home features unique parquet flooring, storybook like fireplace & arched windows in the living room, High ceilings in living & Gracious Formal Dining Room. Breakfast nook with period panels hand painted and built-in buffet, bright kitchen with window overlooking the entry atrium, and access to the hallway with skylight and bedrooms. Two Bedrooms & office/sitting area are situated at the back of the home allowing for privacy, perfect for entertaining. All bedrooms overlook the exceptionally deep and inviting back yard. Bathroom is good sized with tub and separate shower. Lower level offers a very spacious bedroom with walk in closet. At this level there is also a full bath. The very deep attached garage can park 2 maybe 3 cars tandem. High ceilings in the garage offer potential for expansion.Original condition. Close proximity to Ocean Beaches and so much more. New Roof June 2025.
